seeds.scene: A scroll. Top-half key table: rune [A]=H, [B]=E, [C]=L, [D]=O. Bottom-half spell: '[A] [B] [C] [C] [D]'. Each [X] is a unique pictographic rune drawn in the image.
seeds.question: Based strictly on the image (using only the cipher key shown), decode the spell.
seeds.lever: Pure rune-to-letter substitution from a key in the same image.

seeds.scene: A weathered tablet. Left-half key: [A]=A, [B]=R, [C]=G, [D]=O, [E]=N. Right-half word: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image and the key shown, decode the word on the right.

seeds.scene: A bilingual door. Top row: 6 runes [R1] [R2] [R3] [R4] [R5] [R6]. Bottom row: same word in Latin letters partly worn: 'D _ A G _ N' (positions 2 and 5 missing). Runes align position-by-position above Latin letters.
seeds.question: Based on the image (use legible Latin letters to infer mappings + complete the word), what is the full word, and what letter does [R5] correspond to?
seeds.answer: DRAGON; rune [R5] corresponds to letter O
seeds.lever: Cipher inference from partial parallel text + word completion.

seeds.scene: A textbook. Top key: [A]=F, [B]=I, [C]=R, [D]=E, [E]=B, [F]=A, [G]=L. Spell: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E] [F] [G] [G]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the 8-rune spell.

seeds.scene: A library plaque. Key: [A]=W, [B]=I, [C]=S, [D]=D, [E]=O, [F]=M. Central inscription: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E] [F]'. Decorative border has unrelated runes [X] [Y] [Z] NOT part of the inscription.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode ONLY the central inscription line (ignore decorative runes).

seeds.scene: A grimoire. Key: [A]=E, [A']=E (alt form), [B]=N, [C]=R, [D]=G, [E]=Y. Two glyphs [A] and [A'] both map to E. Spell: '[A] [B] [A] [C] [D] [A']'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the spell line; both E-glyphs yield E.

seeds.scene: A banner. Left edge key: [A]=K, [B]=I, [C]=N, [D]=G, [E]=Q, [F]=U, [G]=E. Center text: '[A] [B] [C] [D]   [E] [F] [G] [G] [C]' (clear gap = word break).
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the two-word banner.

seeds.scene: Price board. Key: [N0]=0, [N1]=1, [N2]=2, [N3]=3, [N4]=4, [N5]=5, [N6]=6, [N7]=7. Tag: '[N1] [N4] [N6] gold pieces' (the words 'gold pieces' in plain English).
seeds.question: Based on the image, what numeric price (base-10) is on the tag?

seeds.scene: Codex. Key: [A]=S, [B]=T, [C]=A, [D]=R. Message: '[A] [B] [C] [X] [D]' (5 runes; [X] is NOT in the key).
seeds.question: Based strictly on the image (only keys shown), decode the message — use '_' for any rune not covered.

seeds.scene: Scroll. Key: '[A]=N. Rule: a dot ABOVE the rune doubles its letter; a dot BELOW capitalizes.' Spell line: '[A]' with a single dot drawn directly above it.
seeds.question: Based on the image and the key's rule, decode the spell line.

seeds.scene: Circular medallion. Inner-ring key: [A]=L, [B]=I, [C]=G, [D]=H, [E]=T. Outer ring (clockwise from 12 o'clock): '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the outer-ring word, reading clockwise from 12 o'clock.

seeds.scene: Scroll. Key: [A]=M, [B]=A, [C]=G, [D]=I, [E]=C, [F]=N. Line 1: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'. Line 2: '[F] [B] [F] [B]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode both lines (line 1 followed by line 2).
seeds.lever: Two parallel decodings using one key.

seeds.scene: A treasure map. A small legend box in the lower-right corner (~5% of image area) lists: [A]=N, [B]=O, [C]=R, [D]=T, [E]=H. The map's compass rose label reads: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image (find the legend box first, then decode the compass label), what direction does the label spell?
seeds.lever: Localizing a small key + applying it.

seeds.scene: Inscription panel. Key: '[A]=W (when colored RED) or A (when colored BLUE)'. Each rune in the spell may appear in red or blue ink. Spell: '[A]_red [A]_blue [A]_blue [A]_red' (4 runes; reading left-to-right, the colors are red, blue, blue, red).
seeds.question: Based on the image and the color-conditional rule, decode the 4-rune spell.
seeds.lever: Conditional cipher based on visual attribute (color).

seeds.scene: Fortune card. Key: [A]=Y, [B]=O, [C]=U, [D]=W, [E]=I, [F]=N. Inscription: '[A] [B] [C] , [D] [E] [F] !' (commas and exclamation mark drawn explicitly).
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the inscription preserving punctuation.

seeds.scene: Stone slab. Key: number runes [N0]=0, [N1]=1, [N2]=2, [N3]=3, [N4]=4, [N5]=5, [N6]=6, [N7]=7, [N8]=8, [N9]=9. Plus the operator runes '+' and '='. Equation: '[N4] [N7] + [N1] [N8] = ?'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, evaluate the equation and give the answer (in base-10).

seeds.scene: Stone door. Key: [A]=R, [B]=I, [C]=V, [D]=E, [E]=R. Inscription drawn right-to-left (the rightmost rune is the first letter): '[E] [D] [C] [B] [A]' visually, but the door label says READ THIS RIGHT-TO-LEFT.
seeds.question: Based on the image (reading right-to-left as instructed), decode the inscription.

seeds.scene: Codex with two key sections separated by a heading. Section 1 ('VOWELS'): [V1]=A, [V2]=E, [V3]=I, [V4]=O, [V5]=U. Section 2 ('CONSONANTS'): [C1]=M, [C2]=G, [C3]=C. Spell: '[C1] [V1] [C2] [V3] [C3]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image (using both key sections), decode the spell.

seeds.scene: A spellbook. Key shown: [A]=H, [B]=A, [C]=L, [D]=L, [E]=O. (Note that [C] and [D] both map to L — likely a typo by the scribe, but the key as drawn says so.) Spell: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based strictly on the image (using exactly the keys as shown, even if they map two runes to the same letter), decode the spell.
seeds.lever: Faithful application of the printed key, including duplicates.

seeds.scene: Tavern sign. Key: [A]=S, [B]=U, [C]=N, [D]=L, [E]=I, [F]=G, [G]=H, [H]=T. Sign reads: '[A] [B] [C] - [D] [E] [F] [G] [H]' (with a literal hyphen drawn between two groups).
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the hyphenated compound word.

seeds.scene: A page where the key uses pictures rather than letters. Key: a drawing of a CAT next to the rune [A]; a drawing of a TREE next to [B]; a drawing of a STAR next to [C]; a drawing of a MOON next to [D]. Spell: '[B] [C] [A] [D]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the spell as the sequence of picture-words.

seeds.scene: Society seal. Key: [A]=R, [B]=O, [C]=Y, [D]=A, [E]=L. Below the seal, a tiny acronym in runes: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the acronym.

seeds.scene: Haunted letter. The page contains TWO inscriptions and ONE key. Key (boxed): [A]=H, [B]=E, [C]=L, [D]=P. Inscription 1 (in red ink, in a box labeled 'CIPHER'): '[A] [B] [C] [D]'. Inscription 2 (in plain English, decoy): 'I am fine, do not worry.'
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the CIPHER inscription only (ignore the decoy plain-English line).
seeds.lever: Reading the labeled cipher; ignore decoy plain text.

seeds.scene: Page. Key: [A]=B, [B]=O, [C]=K. Rule note: 'When a rune appears DOUBLED side-by-side ([X][X]), the resulting letter is doubled.' Spell: '[A] [B] [B] [C]' (the [B] glyph appears twice consecutively, indicating a doubled letter per the rule).
seeds.question: Based on the image and the doubling rule, decode the spell.
seeds.lever: Special doubling rule for repeated glyphs.

seeds.scene: A fantasy painting. Below the painting, a small caption strip shows the key first ([A]=D, [B]=R, [C]=A, [D]=G, [E]=O, [F]=N) and then the rune title: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E] [F]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image, decode the painting's title in the caption.
seeds.lever: Standard cipher; tests reading caption strip beneath an image.

seeds.scene: A wanted poster. The main text is in runes (large): '[A] [B] [C] [D]'. In a TINY footer at the bottom of the poster (~3% of poster height), a key is printed: [A]=B, [B]=A, [C]=N, [D]=K.
seeds.question: Based on the image (find and read the tiny footer key first), decode the main text.

seeds.scene: Inscription panel. Half of the key is on the LEFT margin: [A]=W, [B]=A, [C]=T. Half is on the RIGHT margin: [D]=E, [E]=R. Center inscription: '[A] [B] [C] [D] [E]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image (combining both margin halves of the key), decode the center inscription.
seeds.lever: Key combination from spatially split fragments.

seeds.scene: Inscription. Key: [A]=F, [B]=I, [C]=R, [D]=E. Spell: '[A] [B] [C] [?]' where the 4th rune is heavily smudged but its outline is clearly the same as [D] in the key.
seeds.question: Based on the image (identifying the smudged rune by its outline matching [D]), decode the spell.

seeds.scene: Door inscription. Key: [A]=A, [B]=E, [C]=N, [D]=R, [E]=T. The door label says 'REARRANGE THESE LETTERS TO FORM A 5-LETTER WORD'. Runes shown unordered: '[B] [C] [D] [E] [A]'.
seeds.question: Based on the image (decode each rune, then anagram into a common English 5-letter word), what word can be formed?
seeds.answer: ENTER (or one of: ENTER / RANTE — only ENTER is a common English word)

seeds.scene: Inscription. Key: [A]=W (when upright) or M (when rotated 180°). Spell: '[A]_up [A]_down [A]_up' (3 runes; the 1st upright, the 2nd rotated 180°, the 3rd upright).
seeds.question: Based on the image and the orientation-conditional rule, decode the spell.
seeds.lever: Orientation-conditional cipher — same glyph yields different letter when flipped.
